meta.title: Reunion · light continue and persona
meta.description: Not a session mover—use DeepSeek Chat Import for full bubbles. Reunion: light continue (thread ~3.5k chars of background, often an order of magnitude less than a 100k-char thread) plus portable persona (merge/separate). API bills also depend on cache hits—don’t promise a fixed dollar saving. Share/single-session default to thread. Local exports offline; share URLs fetch public snapshots. No telemetry. Continue: import→load; persona: digest/compose/commit. Uninstall never deletes companions/.
